name: banded-lateral-raise
instructions:
1. Stand on a band with a shoulder width stance and your arms hanging at your sides.
2. Inhale and raise the arms laterally to shoulder height using a pronated grip (palms facing down) while keeping the elbows slightly bent.
3. Slowly lower the band back to the starting position under control.
4. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
